messages:
Eli Navarro: quick thread 1: docs style checks: i've been fixing a bunch of pages that mix 'model flavor' and 'model variant'. can we pick one canonical term? also noticed 'latency SLO' and 'latency SLA' used inconsistently.
Rina Park: i'd vote for 'model variant' as canonical. 'flavor' feels casual and will confuse readers. for SLO vs SLA: use 'SLO' in product docs and 'SLA' only when it's contractual in pricing/legal pages.
Omar Salim: +1 to variant. tiny note: our SDK examples sometimes use 'variant' param and sometimes 'model' with suffix. proposal: canonical API param = `model_variant` (snake_case for python), JS = `modelVariant`.
Eli Navarro: good call. can we also add a short glossary entry: "model family" = group of related models (e.g., Redwood-Open family), "model variant" = specific size/quantization/compile (e.g., Redwood-Open-7B-8bit).
Rina Park: i'll draft the glossary entry and push to /docs/glossary.md. i'll include a search redirect for 'model flavor' to land on the variant entry.
Omar Salim: for the SDK migration, let's show both old and new examples in the migration guide. sample snippet: ```python
# old
client.generate(prompt, variant='redwood-open-7b')
# new
client.generate(prompt, model_variant='redwood-open-7b')
```
Eli Navarro: perfect. one more: microcopy in the Console says "Latency SLA: 99th percentile" in a couple places. replace with "Latency SLO" unless referring to the paid SLA. Rina can you scan console copy?
Rina Park: yep, i'll grep the repo for "Latency SLA" and open a doc PR with the replacements + notes where SLA is accurate.
copybot: Auto: created issue #1012 for 'glossary: model variant canonicalization & latency SLO wording' (https://github.com/redwood/docs/issues/1012).
Omar Salim: action owners? Rina = glossary + console copy. Eli = coordinate SDK snippet updates under /docs/sdk/. I'll add the migration blurb to /docs/migration/naming.md.
Eli Navarro: timeline: glossary PR by Tues, SDK snippets by Thurs, migration entry by next Mon. will add checklist to issue.
Rina Park: small style rule to add to docs style guide: on first mention use Title Case for product names (Redwood Dedicated), for technical terms use lowercase except glossary headwords (model variant).
Omar Salim: also add a short lint rule for docs CI that flags uses of 'flavor' and 'latency SLA' so we don't regress. i can draft a small regex check.
Eli Navarro: nice. if anyone finds other stray synonyms (eg 'reserved' vs 'reserved capacity' vs 'Dedicated') please drop them into the issue so we can batch-fix. thanks all :raised_hands: closing once PRs are merged.
